intensity_note: Waterfall imagery is the unweighted mean of the R, G and B channels, which is the quantity the corridor fit operates on. A SatNOGS waterfall is false coloured, so its luma is not its intensity and two different intensities can share a luma.

cards.intensity: unweighted mean of the R, G and B channels, 8-bit

corridor.note: The fitted curve is the predicted Doppler curve shifted by the fitted frequency offset, which is the path the matched filter scored. The predicted curve is the same shape at zero offset, so the gap between them is the measurement. Time runs bottom to top: the first row is the end of the pass. The frequency axis runs against the Doppler sign.

geometry.doppler_note: doppler_hz is null when the record carries no receive frequency, which is the same reason the corridor overlay is withheld on those records. It is not zero, because zero would be a claim.
geometry.note: Elevation is measured from the WGS-84 geodetic normal at the station, which is the same reference the corridor was scored against. Azimuth runs clockwise from true north. The subsatellite point is a geodetic latitude, not a geocentric one.
